description: A survival player holds filled maps over built terrain (pillars of eight blocks at five heights, a pool 1 to 12 deep, glass, waterlogged slabs, leaves, rails and grates, beds, wheat, blocks north of the map): a new map at the origin, the terrain changing under it, a map made far off and held 100 blocks away (the edge of the explored area), maps zoomed once and twice, a locked map and a map in the off hand; each map's colors after each step; Circuit and both official servers give identical output
